title: Ulyana and the Autopsy
author: Silas Kavanagh
blurb: Juniper Whitlock, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
